_comment: La Sportiva sweep 2026-11-07: every adult product on lasportivausa.com (Shopify products.json, 779 products) whose Specs block prints a weight, cited to that line on the product page. Footwear prints one shoe; rows store the pair (2x, arithmetic in the quote). Packs store the Fully Equipped figure where two are printed. The current page wins over a '(2025)'-style older edition, and an older edition is never used when the current page was set aside. Skipped: skis, ski boots and ski hardgoods; kids; laces, hobnails, straps, the pole quiver, Travel Bag and Skimo Bag; the Nepal Work and Ridgeline work boots; the Stratos VI race suit; pages with no weight; pages whose grams and ounces disagree (Comp T-Shirt, Pinnacle Down Jacket Women's, Mantra Pants Women's, Moon Climb Sweater, Nucleo High II GTX Women's, TX1 Women's and others); the Chalk FL tins (two figures, no size); Big Logo and COTM prints at the base product's weight; wide lasts at the standard last's weight; a women's row at exactly the men's weight (kept the men's row); Solution Comp, TX4 EVO ST and Prodigio Max GTX Women's, which share a weight with a product whose name contains theirs; Trail Guard Shorts Men's (prints the pants' 239 g); Chill Jacket Women's (the Chill Thermal Jacket at its weight); and rows already in the catalog (Bushido III, Ethereal Pro Jacket, Lumina 200 Down Jacket). Unsuffixed footwear with a Women's sibling is Men's; without one it carries no fit.
